question.text: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms in PMS require:

answer.text: KYC/CDD, transaction record maintenance and reconstruction, monitoring of suspicious transactions, and prescribed suspicious/cash transaction reporting to FIU-IND

explanation.text: The Logic: Under PMLA, the portfolio manager must conduct KYC/customer due diligence, maintain transaction records sufficient to reconstruct individual transactions, perform enhanced due diligence and increased monitoring of suspicious clients, and file the prescribed suspicious/cash transaction reports to FIU-IND. The Trap: One-time KYC at onboarding, or only bank verification, fall short of the ongoing AML/CFT compliance framework required by the source. Note: The cited source uses the language of KYC, CDD, transaction record reconstruction, suspicious-transaction monitoring, and FIU-IND reporting rather than informal shorthand.
